name: plannotator
description: Interactive Plan Review for Claude Code - annotate plans visually, share with team, automatically send feedback
author: backnotprop

scripts.build:pi: bun run build:review && bun run build:hook && bun run --cwd apps/pi-extension build
scripts.build: bun run build:review && bun run build:hook && bun run build:opencode && bun run build:dsh
scripts.build:viewer-pin: rm -f apps/guides-show/dist/viewer/manifest.json && bun run --cwd apps/guides-show build:viewer && bun run --cwd apps/guides-show sync:manifest
scripts.typecheck: bash apps/pi-extension/vendor.sh && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/acp-client/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ai/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/guide-viewer/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/guides-show/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/relay/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/feedback-service/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.strict-consumer.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/pi-extension/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/hook/hooks/mod/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/hook/tsconfig.server.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/inbox/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/inbox/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/t3-code/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/dsh-plugin/tsconfig.json
